summary: Dennis Cove: rec.gov + FS page confirm $10 single ($20 double), 15 non-electric sites (RV on 9, driveways 30-50 ft), flush toilets, season 04-27..10-13 (2026), reservable on rec.gov, 14-night limit. --AWH creekside consistent with rec.gov's Riverfront tags on 05-08 (Laurel Fork under canopy). Pin ~260 m off the loop. Phone missing.
flags: PIN: stored 36.2568,-82.1132 sits ~260 m west of the campground loop in forest; the catalog site points centre on 36.2566,-82.1103 (sites 01-14 within ~60 m of it). Suggest moving the pin there.
PHONE: none stored -> 423-735-1500 (Watauga Ranger District, on both the FS page and recreation.gov).

WATERFRONT (--AWH creekside, not changed): consistent. recreation.gov tags sites 05, 06, 07 and 08 'Riverfront' (Laurel Fork Creek, a mountain stream well under 30 m wide, along the south side of the loop ~36.2565,-82.1103); canopy hides the bank on Esri imagery, so imagery neither confirms nor vetoes. RV equipment is permitted on 05-08 except 07 (van/RV/tent, no trailer).
ACCESS (not a drop): rec.gov 'Dennis Cove Road is steep with hairpin turns, so plan to drive slowly'; FS 'steep and windy, with lots of switchbacks'. No rig restriction is stated; put in the note.

FACILITIES: the FS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' while recreation.gov lists Drinking Water and Water Spigot; the FS line is the r08 template (it also appears on Rock Creek's page), so potable_water true was written from rec.gov - reviewer may prefer to leave it unset.
FIT: 4 of the 13 standard sites (04, 10, 12, 14) do not list RV as permitted equipment; RV sites 01-03, 05-09, 11 have 30-50 ft driveways. No posted rig cap.
